reviews.title: Estafa!!! Cobro no autorizado
reviews.text: Se cobró un monto, sin mencionar que se haría, solicitó un reembolso, súper inseguro.

reviews.title: Unreliable
reviews.text: It’s the second time this month that I press record and after 10-20 minutes I notice that it’s stuck on 0:00 and I missed important recordings.

reviews.title: Please fix
reviews.text: When recording from the Apple Watch the recording you can’t play on loudspeaker it only plays with the earpiece like when you’re on a call to somebody that’s the only way you can hear the recording it does not be on loudspeaker. There is no option. Please fix this.

reviews.title: BROKEN STORAGE
reviews.text: This app is flat awful at maintaining or storing recordings. Once you record something, it is a near guarantee it will fail to send it to your phone (or save it at all sometimes). The app in its entirety behaves as a beta phase program, and relying on it has cost me vast amounts of important recordings. Unless beating your head against a wall is a frequent hobby already, please, invest in a digital recorder.

reviews.title: Sketchy Transcription
reviews.text:
Tried to transcribe the same 45-second clip three times and it failed to transcribe complete or accurately for all three attempts.

It recorded them fine, but failed to completely convert to text.

reviews.title: Doesn't sync with watch
reviews.text: Refuses to fetch recordings from my watch. That's literally the whole point. But wait! IT GETS WORSE. It will automatically delete recordings on my watch after they're a week old! So I will surely lose this data. This app is literal garbage.
